text:
mira: @sec-team @eng-identity ACME reports mass SCIM sync failures after a scheduled key rotation. They say new hires aren't provisioning and deprovision events are missing from audit logs for a ~60d window. Also seeing a billing spike tied to retries. Root error from customer: 403 on PUT /scim/v2/Users. Raising for urgent triage.

samir: can you paste a sample request/response and the request_id? any recent RBAC changes or service principal updates?

mira: request_id=rcp_20240321_8a9f; sample curl below. They run Private deployment (VPC) + customer-managed KMS (HSM).

mira: ```
curl -i -X PUT "https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Users/urn:indy:123" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/scim+json' \
  -d '{"active": true, "userName": "jdoe@example.com"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope", "message":"token failed unwrap: decrypt error"}
```

jess: probability high that HSM key rotation changed the key ID used for token unwrapping or for KMS-wrapped service credentials. If tokens can't be unwrapped, SCIM service treats requests as unauthenticated -> 403. Also audit pipeline might have missed events while rotation was in-flight.

alex: I see a config drift in the customer's key metadata: key_id in secret `scim-service/wrap-key` points to old key. Verified in customer vault snapshot at 2024-03-21T03:12Z.

samir: quick repro steps for oncall to validate: 1) run `redwood-admin keys list --env acme` and confirm active key_id; 2) run a decrypt check `redwood-admin kms decrypt --key <id> --ciphertext <sample>`; 3) retry SCIM PUT with a freshly minted token. If decrypt fails, rotate wrapper or rewrap service credentials.

jess: audit retention note: ACME requested 180d retention but console shows 90d for `prod-a`. Likely policy mismatch between customer retention setting and the log-archiver role for their Private deploy. Need to open a config rollback and run backfill for missing events if possible.

mira: billing spike: support-bot attached invoice diff. Looks like clients retried every 30s for ~2h after failures, leading to doubled token/embedding usage. Ticket #SUP-4126.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-20240321-ACME-SCIM. Assigned to eng-identity (samir) and eng-security (jess). Pager duty notify sent.

samir: immediate mitigation plan: 1) re-point `scim-service/wrap-key` to current key_id (with approval from sec); 2) rewrap credentials and restart scim-service in staged canary; 3) run targeted resync for affected users; 4) backfill audit events from the buffer (if available). I can own steps 1-2.

jess: sec checklist: confirm key rotation auth chain, verify HSM logs for rotation time, sign-off on rewrap. Also request least-privilege review: the scim-service principal currently has `org:read, user:write, audit:read` — propose removing any admin scopes not required.

mira: forwarded customer consent to rewrap and restart. Also asked for a list of impacted users to prioritize backfill.

alex: quick sanity check output from decrypt test: `redwood-admin kms decrypt --key a1b2c3 --ciphertext x` -> ERROR: unwrap failed (CKM_TOKEN_UNWRAP_ERROR). Matches HSM rotation window.

samir: taking ownership. I'll coordinate with jess for sec sign-off and post runbook steps here. ETA first pass in 30m.

mira: thanks — keeping ACME updated. :thumbsup:

alex: adding note: create a post-incident action item to add an automated check that validates service key_id mappings after KMS rotations to prevent silent auth breaks.

jess: +1. Also add an audit retention sanity check that warns if requested retention != active retention.

mira: ack. I'll update INC-20240321-ACME-SCIM with timeline and next steps.

samir: done: status=investigating, logs attached to incident.

mira: closing thread here, will post final remediation summary when cleanup finished. :white_check_mark:
